title: Persist owner review changes and include newly saved reviews in public counts

endpoints.before: The legacy editor could fail to persist an owner's changes, leaving the earlier text and rating in subsequent review lists. The review form could also fail to locate a valid product after the origin started.
endpoints.after: After a successful edit and cache refresh, the list reflects the owner's saved review. Each edit keeps the review's identity and appends the prior version to its history. New reviews for resolved products appear after the same cache refresh.

endpoints.before: The legacy editor sent an invalid MongoDB update, so an attempted rating or recommendation change could leave the original values in the summary. The review form could also fail to locate a valid product after the origin started.
endpoints.after: After a successful owner edit and cache refresh, the summary uses the saved rating, recommendation and verification status. Editing a review keeps the review count for the offer. New reviews for resolved products appear after the same cache refresh.
